source.selection: IC19 without SK atmospheric data; NO local-minimum best fit and symmetric one-sigma errors; pinned archive, not latest release

assumptions: Diagonal covariance is an explicit approximation; no measured correlations supplied.
Asymmetric one-sigma errors symmetrized by arithmetic mean.
Dirac phase omitted because its likelihood is non-Gaussian and periodic.
No ordering preference, cosmology, 0vbbeta or global Zee acceptance included.

NuFIT 6.0 publishes official one-, two-, and three-dimensional profiled delta-chi-squared projections, but not a single joint six-observable likelihood in this record. Projections are not combined because that would invent cross-observable correlations.
